reviews.title: Great prenatal workouts
reviews.text: Love the multiple prenatal workout options to help baby and me stay healthy during pregnancy and work out safely.

reviews.title: My go-to 4eva and eva
reviews.text: I’ve been moving with TSS since the pandemic and even though I’m devoted to 2-3x a week reformer or studio classes, it’s the one workout that I keep coming back to because I feel great after, I feel and look noticeably stronger, and the quickies meet me where I’m at as a busy mom. Keep it on your workout rotation — you won’t regret it!

reviews.title: Love this app!!
reviews.text: I adore this app and these programs - thank you TSS!

reviews.title: Great at home workouts!
reviews.text: As a stay at home mom this app has been so helpful in giving me ways to move my body on my own schedule! The work outs are amazing, and I love that there are quick classes when I am on a time crunch.

reviews.title: Obsessed….
reviews.text:
I decided to give yet another fitness app a try, and I’m so glad I did!

This program combines so many of my favorite styles of training, and the results have been incredible. After just the first week, I could already see and feel a difference in my strength, endurance, flexibility, and even my overall appearance.

The free trial makes it an easy decision because you truly have nothing to lose and so much to gain. More strength, better flexibility, increased confidence… what more could you ask for?

Highly recommend! A+++

reviews.title: Life changing
reviews.text: TSS changed my life. So inspirational every single day. I’m so grateful for this. I am happy when I work out and I’m finally coming back to my best self. Thank you!

reviews.title: Like a reliable lifelong friend!
reviews.text: I’ve been doing TSS on and off since 2019 and it is the perfect at home workout! Challenging, fun, and feels good. I recommend it to all my girlfriends! It’s especially amazing for work trips and vacations.

reviews.title: Praises from a Pilates teacher!
reviews.text: I have been loving these classes! All the instructors are so encouraging and gets detailed instruction and their videos. I love the variety and I look forward to my workouts.

reviews.title: Love this work out
reviews.text: Love these work outs so much. Strength training that just feels good and makes sense.

reviews.title: Best at home workout
reviews.text: The best tool to get me back in shape and feeling good in my body postpartum! Love the variety!!

reviews.title: Well rounded fitness app
reviews.text: Megan is wonderful (so is Katy!). The dancing arms is worth the subscription alone. You can mix and match the quickies together. She puts a lot of effort into fresh content.

reviews.title: Keeps my body functioning!
reviews.text: Favorite workout. They sneak in things you would do at physical therapy to keep your body in working order but youre having so much fun that you dont even realize it! Megan is so kind and motivating. The rest of the instructors all have such wonderful personalities as well.

reviews.title: Love Megan & her crew!
reviews.text: One of the things I appreciate most about The Sculpt Society is how easy it makes it to incorporate movement throughout my day. The workouts feel approachable and flexible, so I don't have to set aside a full hour to feel like I've accomplished something. Even on busy days, I can fit in a quick class, and those small sessions really add up. It's helped me build a more consistent routine and view movement as something I can naturally weave into my day instead of another item on my to-do list. The variety of workouts and encouraging instruction keep me motivated, making it much easier to stay active in a way that feels sustainable and enjoyable.

reviews.title: Great for Pregnancy/Postpartum
reviews.text: I originally started using the app during my first pregnancy and have continued through their postpartum programs. It’s been wonderful and is the perfect amount of spice. It’s also been very manageable with a new baby.

reviews.title: The only workout I’ve stuck with
reviews.text: I’m 6 months postpartum and did a different postpartum workout plan but after finishing was looking for something that would keep me interested in working out and after giving this a try with a 5 week free trial, I was hooked! So fun and so many different kinds and intensities of workouts. I haven’t worked out consistently in years and now I am sad on the days I don’t get my workout in.

reviews.title: Best exercise at home!
reviews.text: Love all the routines and the pace, there’s so much to choose from. Can do everyday

reviews.title: my fav workout app!
reviews.text: so fun and easy to follow

reviews.title: Consistent Prenatal Movement
reviews.text: The weekly calendar and quick workouts have me keeping a consistent workout routine during my pregnancy. I also love the inclusion of pelvic floor exercises - so important!

reviews.title: Loving TSS
reviews.text: Great workouts, it’s easy to be consistent!!

reviews.title: Love!
reviews.text: I absolutely love this app!!

reviews.title: Confidence skyrocketed!!
reviews.text: I’ve been doing the sculpt society for 4 months and absolutely love it. Meghan has redefined my relationship with working out. She’s so positive in her workouts and her philosophy of doing 20-30 minute workouts 4-6 times a week compared to pushing yourself till burnout is very effective. I’ve gotten so many complements on how toned my arms are now and people have complimented my posture. I love that I can take this workout anywhere and there are so many variations. I feel so confident and truly look forward to the sculpt society workouts. I encourage everyone to try!

reviews.title: Having a Workout Bestie 24/7
reviews.text: So great - I started TSS after a friend recommended it 4 years ago and immediately fell in love. At home, workouts for every kind of day, and they’ve continued to expand their library with fun challenges and new videos!

reviews.title: Apple TV app doesn’t work
reviews.text: Downloaded and can’t login. Tried to hard restart my Apple TV as well as uninstall and reinstall the app. It just hangs up when trying to login every time. This was one the reasons I got a subscription to this app instead of others so very disappointing

reviews.title: LOVE
reviews.text: Really enjoying the Postpartum Program!! 10/10 recommend!

reviews.title: Phenomenal workouts!
reviews.text: Megan always keeps it fresh and exciting and the live workouts keep me coming back every day!

reviews.title: TSS makes consistent movement possible
reviews.text: I have been with TSS since November of 2025 and it is the only form of exercise that has been consistently energizing and accessible in my life as a mom of young kids! I’m so grateful and immediately noticed my body craving the quick, challenging movement I can infuse into my day with just 20 or so minutes. Love this entire team and so thankful for the support!! 💪🏼

reviews.title: Love!
reviews.text: I started TSS last year to help me through my pregnancy and am still loving it now that I’m postpartum. They have exactly what I need to help ease back into exercise, especially coming back from an unplanned c-section, with current goals of rebuilding my core and overall strength. The app is easy to navigate, the videos are quick and so convenient, and the overall vibe is supportive and motivational. Love it! Can’t wait to continue with the other TSS programs as my goals shift!

reviews.title: Wanna be lover
reviews.text: I want to love this app and program as I’ve seen so many people rave about it. But the workouts are chaotic and I’m sorely disappointed. Very little prompting for the upcoming moves and half the time I have no idea what is next. Not to mention the instructors do moves the wrong way I fear I will injure myself if I follow their lead. I’ve had personal trainers and know proper forms.

reviews.title: Loving the PP programs!!!
reviews.text: I am 9 weeks PP and have been doing the PP programs since about 1 week PP and have absolutely been loving them!! The pelvic floor and core program has made a HUGE difference in my recovery with my 3rd baby! My provider even commented on how impressed she was with my pelvic floor strength at my 6 week check up! I can’t wait to continue to utilize these workouts throughout my first year PP! I am loving the 2nd phase program with the short workouts and the ones with the solly wrap making it so doable!!

reviews.title: Obsessed!
reviews.text: They offer so much variety! And the instructors are all so engaged and motivating. Highly recommend ❤️💪🏼

reviews.title: Helped me coming back from an injury!
reviews.text: There’s really something for everyone with this program!

reviews.title: I never thought working out from home would would work for me
reviews.text: With TSS, I am able to complete multiple workouts every week, which is a lot more than I was able to do as a busy working mom when trying to attend a gym.  The classes are challenging and fun.

reviews.title: Sculpt Society Review
reviews.text: So fabulous!! Look forward to working out every day—-so much fun!!

reviews.title: love the vids, difficult UX
reviews.text: great videos but with the programs would be automatically added to the calendar or an “up next” feature. no idea why the daily videos aren’t loaded into the built in calendar either

reviews.title: Obsessed
reviews.text: I finally look forward to my workouts!!! AND finally feel like the parts of my body that needed attention are getting it especially as a C-section mama who doesn’t have a ton of time. Absolutely amazing!

reviews.title: FAKE REVIEWS!
reviews.text: After seeing Megan on IG and reading a bunch of these reviews, I tried this app and something felt very off. The instructors didn’t seem very knowledgeable and the workouts are uninspired at best. I went back through the App Store and realized that most of these reviews are fake! I work in tech and can usually spot but was fooled at first. You can tell from certain word repetition, post timing, short and non-specific language. So lame. Don’t fall for it like I did. I cancelled and signed up for a better app.

reviews.title: Love it!
reviews.text: TSS is so great!  Been super helpful to have this app and especially the quickie workouts to incorporate into very busy and inevitably interrupted days as a mom.

reviews.title: Best work from home app for full time workers and busy moms
reviews.text: The consistency of doing 10-30 minute work outs is amazing for busy working full time moms ! Love all the classes for so many different stages of life. Good workout and positive work out instructions that get it !

reviews.title: Love it!
reviews.text: I love love love these workouts! So fun and you can feel it

reviews.title: My favorite work out app!
reviews.text: I love everything I get with this app! I am learning how to meditate and really how to have a better relationship with food with the new year program!! I have another workout app that I use sometimes but I like thus one the best because of Megan there is just something about her that makes me feel good! I highly recommend this!!!

reviews.title: Postpartum
reviews.text: I’ve been loving the slowness, the techniques, and the follow along videos during this PP phase. It’s so great to ease back into workouts and review some of the videos to improve my technique and stamina.

reviews.title: Love love love!
reviews.text: I found the scalp society a little over a month ago and I am loving it! There are a wide variety of classes and option for whatever stage of workout you’re in!

reviews.title: The best workout app!!!
reviews.text: Meghan is amazing and I’m loving Bree being incorporated cause she’s the best at strength training. And the music… chef’s kiss

reviews.title: Been a member for 4 years!
reviews.text: It just keeps getting better!

reviews.title: best workout app ever!!
reviews.text: i’ve tried every online workout there is, this one is the best! this one truly has something for everyone. best part is all can be done at home, with or without weights. i love how engaging all the instructors are and how there are so many options for length of workout + intensity. a must have if pregnant/postpartum 💗

reviews.title: Hands down BEST workout
reviews.text: I’ve tried every home workout under this sun. TSS is the best workout of them all. This app isn’t just about the physical, TSS is about being your best & strongest self physically, emotionally, mentally. I am a better version of me with this program. And It is so fun (great music!). It doesn’t feel like a workout, more like a fun get together with your friends. and you see RESULTS! I look forward to my TSS sweat sesh every day. Thank you to Megan & the entire TSS dream team.

reviews.title: Best ever!!
reviews.text: Love Megan and the team! Amazing classes that I actually stick to and love. Always feel my best doesn’t matter if I took a 10 min arms or 45 min full body sculpt. Can’t recco enough.

reviews.title: Spicy, convenient, and fun
reviews.text: I’ve been a member of TSS for I think 5 years now and I am obsessed. The classes, the teachers, the challenges and programs all keep me coming back to my mat each day!

reviews.title: Love through every season of life!
reviews.text: Through wedding prep, pregnancy, postpartum, and on, I love these workouts and keep coming back!

reviews.title: The best!
reviews.text: Been a member since 2020 and love the low commitment and varied workout styles on the app! The app is easy to use and they don’t try to do too much with the features which I love!
